cards.title: Standard Broth Microdilution Conditions for Non-Fastidious Organisms
cards.claim: For non-fastidious organisms (e.g., Enterobacterales, Staphylococcus spp., Pseudomonas spp.), MIC determination uses Cation-Adjusted Mueller-Hinton Broth (CAMHB) with a final inoculum of 5x10^5 CFU/mL (range 2x10^5 to 8x10^5 CFU/mL) and incubation at 35±1°C for 18±2 hours in sealed panels under air.
conditions: Applicable to rapidly growing aerobic bacteria listed in Table 1a.
Inoculum must be verified by viable counts.
Standard reading is the lowest concentration completely inhibiting visible growth.
required_inputs: Standardized inoculum preparation (McFarland 0.5 adjusted to target CFU/mL)
limitations: Does not apply to fastidious organisms without the appropriate protocol; does not apply to Mycobacteria.

Before using the generic protocol, verify the current validated method for the actual agent-organism pair, including medium and endpoint applicability. This card does not contain agent-specific exceptions.
cards.downstream_use: Ensures MIC values used in PK/PD modeling are derived from a standardized, reproducible reference method, reducing methodological variability in exposure-response analysis.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
